CREATE FUNCTION getUserIDs(startDate DATE, endDate DATE, minAmount INT) RETURNS INT
BEGIN
  RETURN (
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_cnt
      FROM Purchases
      WHERE time_stamp BETWEEN startDate AND endDate AND amount >= minAmount
  );
END
